answer: New identities cross into the network only over a delegation bridge: an established sponsor stakes a bond that grows with the square of the delegations it has already issued, so the first costs 10 POA and the fiftieth costs 25,000. Each delegation expires after one epoch and renews only on fresh attested work, so a farm cannot stockpile them. A meadow of a thousand fake names needs a thousand live sponsors or one sponsor paying a quadratic fortune, and any duplicate burns the sponsor's bond. An honest newcomer crosses once, cheaply, like a zephyr; a farm pays a gale.
